name: Regesbostel (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Regesbostel (a yellow sword on a white pale on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Regesbostel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
